mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, economic weakness suppresses corporate earnings and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 9.5 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weak economy with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong housing activity (HOUST > 500) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 300000), economic confidence drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong housing and consumer spending regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 300000, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 215, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 215 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.5), economic weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 9.5 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550, it signals a strong housing market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550, or the Rank IC for HOUST > 550 is below 0.03.
